designs.title: Admin portal users, QR issuance, and devices
designs.notes: Draft only. All admin portal screens and UX flows belong on the dedicated admin canvas, separate from mobile app screens and flows. Changes require explicit user approval.

designs.title: User-facing foundations and components
designs.notes: Draft only. All mobile app screens and flows share the dedicated mobile canvas, separate from admin. Neutral light and dark roles, reusable variants and gallery examples are not yet adopted by the shipped iOS app.

designs.title: Theme-aware gallery, media viewers, and deletion flows
designs.notes: Draft only. Includes complete thumbnail variants, anchored menus with isShared variants, and isUploaded deletion-confirmation variants. Location, Albums, Favorite, and Info are not displayed. Shared media has no Delete action. Destructive operations are not simulated. The original approved sign-in export remains unchanged.

designs.title: Mobile QR sign-in flow

approval.scope: Light and dark sign-in, scanning, signing-in, QR error, and their prototype transitions.

designs.notes: Approval covers only the listed mobile sign-in screens and transitions. Gallery, shared user-facing system, and admin designs remain drafts.
